answer: Faking thousands of identities means posting real collateral for each, and forged proofs get slashed, so an attacker's cost scales linearly while honest agents pay almost nothing. Sybil resistance can work through a staked identity relic: each agent locks collateral in a registry, and every epoch a random pulse of peers must co-sign a liveness proof. If a cluster of fakes fails the pulse, the registry quarantines it into a canyon of frozen stake, making mass impersonation economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0062's threat model.
